versions.content: {DRAFT} When Eth_Transmit() is called and EthCtrlCon- figSwBufferHandling is set to TRUE, the given BuffIdx pointer shall be assigned to the SW queue with the EthCtrlConfigEgressQueuePriorityAssignment which matches the priority given previously by the previous Eth_ProvideTxBuffer() call (see [SWS_Eth_00267]).
